# A test reaches no network unless it says so, on every target: a request
# fails "no answer for" its url until the test sets sngl:http's answer, to
# a function answering it or to http.network. Port 1 refuses, so the last
# test's request reached for the network and failed some other way.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component page(path string = "a") ui.node {
    var got = ""

    effect(@mount {
        match var r = http.get("http://127.0.0.1:1/{path}") {
            ok { got = "{r.status} {r.body}" }
            failed { got = r.message }
        }
    })
    ui.text(got)
}

func greet(r http.Request) option[http.Response] {
    if r.url.endsWith("/hi") {
        return http.Response{status=200, headers={}, body="hello"}
    }
    return null
}

func testARequestIsClosedInATest(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.wait(func() => c.got != "", 2000)
    t.assert(c.got == "no answer for http://127.0.0.1:1/a")
}

func testAnAnswerAnswersIt(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, greet)
    c.path = "hi"
    t.wait(func() => c.got != "", 2000)
    t.assert(c.got == "200 hello")
}

func testTheNetworkIsReachedWhenTheTestSaysSo(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, http.network)
    t.wait(func() => c.got != "", 2000)
    t.assert(c.got != "no answer for http://127.0.0.1:1/a")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
